node.title: Conditional F-4 minimal-record direct-column budget
node.statement: At every official X4/list corridor row, use the fixed quotient, dihedral, moment-trade, U2-boundary, and DLI/skew first-owner strips. Let R_h^min be the remaining width-h records in the established u1 direct-column convention that satisfy the F-4 minimal condition e_j(P)=e_j(Q) for 1<=j<=h-1, let R_1^min=0 be the singleton bookkeeping term, and let H_max=min(k+t,floor(n/2)). Then, conditional on f3_h3_direct_floor_conditional_close and f3_hge4_aggregate_budget, R_min=R_1^min+R_2^min+R_3^min+sum_{h=4}^{H_max}R_h^min<16n^3. Indeed the four terms are respectively 0, <n^3, <n^3, and <=14n^3. This node bounds only the F-4 minimal-record currency. It does not assert that every general order-t primitive star-PTE record is minimal or that R_min equals the post-strip exact-list residue; x4_primitive_star_u1_coverage owns that separate coverage and multiplicity theorem.
node.attack_surface: the h=3 C36 chain and the h>=4 norm-gate aggregate for fully stripped F-4 minimal records at every official corridor row
node.falsifier: A complete official row or certified slice, in the exact five-strip F-4 minimal-record convention, whose transported contribution forces R_min>=16n^3; pre-strip counts and general nonminimal star records do not falsify this node.
node.notes: Currency correction 2026-08-06: the h=2 theorem counts equal-e1 records, the h=3 theorem counts equal-(e1,e2) records, and HGE4 explicitly carries the F-4 order-(h-1) scope pin. The previous node headline silently called their sum the entire primitive exact-list residue. That missing general-to-minimal passage is now owned by x4_primitive_star_u1_coverage. Historical experiments, catches, and route development remain in this node's notes directory and QUALITY.md; they are evidence for the minimal ledger, not a coverage proof.
